vectors.description: SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS with single-element prefix (results in PUBLISH messages for matching tracks)
SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS with multi-element prefix
SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS with PAUSED (0x11) = 1: each resulting subscription starts paused. Draft-22 sent the same request as FORWARD (0x10) = 0
SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS with AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN parameter (USE_VALUE type=0, value='tracks-tok'). Section 9.19.2 forbids copying it into the resulting PUBLISH
SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS with zero-element prefix (subscribes to all tracks)
SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS with GROUP_ORDER parameter (descending=2)
SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS with INCLUDE_PROPERTIES (0x35) set to 0 — the resulting PUBLISH messages should carry an empty Track Properties field

SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS with TRACK_PROPERTY_FILTER (0x29): SetID 0, Track Property Type 0x0E, value range 1-1. Section 3.6.2: "AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN and TRACK_PROPERTY_FILTER apply to the SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS itself."

SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS with OBJECTID_FILTER (0x26): SetID 0, Object ID range 0-4. Section 3.6.2 says the publisher uses such parameters "as the initial Subscription parameters when a PUBLISH is sent as a result of SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS, and includes those in the PUBLISH." Section 9.8 does not list OBJECTID_FILTER for PUBLISH. The two sections disagree, and the vector asserts the decode only

SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS carrying TRACK_PROPERTY_FILTER twice: DEFAULT_PUBLISHER_PRIORITY (0x0E) equal to 1 in set 0, and DEFAULT_PUBLISHER_GROUP_ORDER (0x22) between 1 and 2 in set 1. Section 3.3.2: "The Track Property filter parameter MAY appear multiple times in a SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS message or REQUEST_UPDATE for it."

SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS carrying a type 0x05 LOCATION_FILTER, so each resulting subscription joins its Track at the Next Object. Section 9.17: "The parameters that can appear in a SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS are OBJECT_DELIVERY_TIMEOUT, AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN, SUBGROUP_DELIVERY_TIMEOUT, PAUSED, SUBSCRIBER_PRIORITY, LOCATION_FILTER, GROUP_ORDER, FILL_PARAMETERS, SUBGROUP_FILTER, OBJECTID_FILTER, PRIORITY_FILTER, OBJECT_PROPERTY_FILTER, TRACK_PROPERTY_FILTER and INCLUDE_PROPERTIES."

SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS carrying a type 0x05 LOCATION_FILTER followed by an empty FILL_PARAMETERS (Type Delta 2, Number of Parameters 0), the pair Section 3.6.2 names for joining the Tracks the resulting PUBLISHes start
SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS carrying FILL_PARAMETERS (0x23) alone, its value a type 0x02 LOCATION_FILTER selecting the fill range {100,0} onward for each resulting subscription

SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS carrying OBJECT_DELIVERY_TIMEOUT (0x02), 5000 ms. Section 9.19.4: "It MAY appear in a SUBSCRIBE, PUBLISH, SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS, or REQUEST_UPDATE (for a subscription) message." Draft-22 refused it here

SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS carrying SUBGROUP_DELIVERY_TIMEOUT (0x06), 5000 ms. Section 9.19.3: "It MAY appear in a SUBSCRIBE, PUBLISH, SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS, or REQUEST_UPDATE (for a subscription) message." Draft-22 refused it here

SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS carrying SUBSCRIBER_PRIORITY (0x20), 32. Section 9.17: "The parameters that can appear in a SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS are OBJECT_DELIVERY_TIMEOUT, AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN, SUBGROUP_DELIVERY_TIMEOUT, PAUSED, SUBSCRIBER_PRIORITY, LOCATION_FILTER, GROUP_ORDER, FILL_PARAMETERS, SUBGROUP_FILTER, OBJECTID_FILTER, PRIORITY_FILTER, OBJECT_PROPERTY_FILTER, TRACK_PROPERTY_FILTER and INCLUDE_PROPERTIES." Draft-22 refused it here
SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS carrying SUBSCRIBER_PRIORITY=64 and a type 0x05 LOCATION_FILTER: 02 20 40 01 05

SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS carrying RENDEZVOUS_TIMEOUT (0x04), 3000 ms. Section 3.6.2: "Parameters that only apply to a SUBSCRIBE for a single Track, such as RENDEZVOUS_TIMEOUT and NEW_GROUP_REQUEST, cannot appear in SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS." Section 9.19.1: "If a parameter appears in some other type of message, the receiving endpoint MUST close the session with INVALID_PARAMETER."
vectors.error_detail: RENDEZVOUS_TIMEOUT may appear in SUBSCRIBE only

vectors.error_detail: NEW_GROUP_REQUEST may appear in SUBSCRIBE or REQUEST_UPDATE for a subscription only

vectors.description: SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS carrying SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS_ID (0x36). Section 9.19.21: "It appears only in a PUBLISH sent as a result of a SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS". vectors.error_detail: SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS_ID may appear only in PUBLISH

vectors.description: SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS carrying draft-22's FORWARD (0x10) = 0. Draft-23's Table 14 has no row for 0x10: PAUSED (0x11) replaced FORWARD. Section 9.19: "An endpoint that receives an unknown Message Parameter MUST close the session with INVALID_PARAMETER."
vectors.error_detail: message parameter type 0x10 is not defined by draft-23
